free_design.Place: The props alcove at a small village shadow-puppet theatre, beside a stained glass window and an open wooden trunk.
free_design.Activity: During rehearsal she tries the hinge on an old brass lantern puppet after removing the bulky shoulder piece of her lamplighter costume so it will not snag on the strings.
free_design.Pose: She stands front three-quarter with elbows apart, her right hand holding the wooden puppet control near her chin and her left hand holding the lantern puppet by its brass loop.
free_design.Framing: Vertical knees-up composition with the face lit by the window and both hands visible against the plain trunk and plaster wall.
free_design.Outfit: An original stage lamplighter costume with a fitted opaque blackberry velvet square-neck bodice, a short gold-striped skirt, and leather ankle boots. The detachable shoulder piece rests across the open trunk, leaving both shoulders bare.
